name: checkbox
description: A yes/no choice with a visible label.

use.when: a yes or no the person decides.
use.not: showing a state, which is a badge.
use.with: text-field and select, in a form the assistant built because a form was the better thing.

required.description: Only for a box that must be ticked to go on, such as agreeing to something. Says (required) in words.

error.description: What to do, when the box had to be ticked and was not. Sets aria-invalid and is linked with aria-describedby.

keyboard.does: moves focus to and from the checkbox

wcag.notes: Native input so the checked state is exposed everywhere. The label is clickable and the target is at least 44px tall. The name never changes with the state; the box says checked. Required is said in words, and an error is text above the box, tied to it (3.3.1).

machine.identify: The accessible name is the label text. Read the checked property.
machine.operate: Click the input or its label, or focus it and press Space.

props.label: Remind me the day before
props.name: remind
props.hint: A reminder rings at 9:00 the day before it is due.

props.label: I have saved a copy of this workspace
props.name: saved
props.error: Tick the box to say you have a copy, or go back and make one first.
